newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan concludes loan talks with World Bank.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan concludes loan talks with World Bank.

text.p: Pakistan concluded talks with the World Bank for a loan to support banking and financial sector reform on Thursday, a senior official said.
"The amount will be determined later, but it is a fast-disbursing loan," Moeen Afzal, Secretary at the Finance Ministry, told Reuters.
"We have successfuly concluded discussions on the loan. Now, it will be put before our cabinet, and the World Bank will put it before its management for a decision," Afzal said.
He said Shahid Javed Burki, adviser to caretaker Prime Minister Meraj Khalid, was expected to complete the loan agreement during a visit to Washington early next month.

President Farooq Leghari installed a caretaker government with a 90-day mandate to supervise elections after dismissing the National Assembly and sacking prime minister Benazir Bhutto on disputed charges of corruption and misrule on November 5.
